description: This file declares the ControllerFactory class which implements the IControllerFactory interface, providing a method to create shared pointers to google::protobuf::RpcController objects. It is part of the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace and appears to be a factory class for IPC controller objects.

classes.name: ControllerFactory
classes.description: Implements IControllerFactory to create and manage RPC controller objects for IPC communication.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a google::protobuf::RpcController object.
